title: Linearity and naturality of completed pullback, direct image, and exchange
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and put $A=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi)$ and $P_n=A/\varpi^n$ for a uniformizer $\varpi$ and $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use the completed coefficient sheaf $A_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$ and $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\mathcal C_W$ be its full subcategory of derived $I$-complete objects [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with the $A$-linear structure [def-weil-linear-category] induced by constant sections of $A_W$.

For every morphism of schemes $u:U\to V$, the canonical map $u^{-1}A_V\to A_U$ is the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Derived module direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] along $u^{-1}A_V\to A_U$ restricts to a functor $D_u=Ru_*:\mathcal C_U\to\mathcal C_V$. Completed pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] is a functor $P_u=Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}:\mathcal C_V\to\mathcal C_U$. Both functors are additive and $A$-linear [def-weil-linear-functor], and $P_u\dashv D_u$. For a second morphism $v:Z\to U$, the canonical composition isomorphism $P_vP_u\cong P_{u\circ v}$ is natural.

For any cartesian square of schemes $f:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$, $h:Y\to X$, $e:Y\to T$ with $f h=g e$ [sbc-def-base-change-square], these composition comparisons give $\theta:P_hP_f\xrightarrow{\sim}P_eP_g$. Write $\eta_h$ for the unit of $P_h\dashv D_h$ and $\varepsilon_g$ for the counit of $P_g\dashv D_g$. The canonical integral completed exchange is the natural transformation with components
$$
 \alpha_K=D_h(P_e(\varepsilon_{g,K}))\circ D_h(\theta_{D_gK})\circ\eta_{h,P_fD_gK}:
 P_fD_gK\longrightarrow D_hP_eK\qquad(K\in\mathcal C_T).
$$
In particular, for every $a:K\to K'$ in $\mathcal C_T$,
$$D_hP_e(a)\circ\alpha_K=\alpha_{K'}\circ P_fD_g(a).$$
Under the canonical finite-reduction comparisons [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-pullback-reduction, prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] and direct-image/derived-limit comparisons [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits], this specified mate is the completed exchange obtained from the finite-level exchange transformations. This assertion imposes no smoothness, properness or constructibility hypothesis and asserts no invertibility of $\alpha_K$.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] and [lem-weil-valued-dvr-finite-quotients], $A$ is Noetherian with finite quotients. The free resolution $[A\xrightarrow{\varpi^n}A]$ makes $P_n$ perfect; its finite additive group is torsion. Thus the adic datum applies. The coefficient isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image] preserve scalars, quotients and composition.

Ordinary operations are linear by [lem-sbc-ambient-operations-scalar-linearity]. In the explicit Koszul completion $C_W$ [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], maps are products of $s\otimes1$ followed by a two-summand fibre, so $C_W(as)=aC_W(s)$ and $C_W(s+t)=C_W(s)+C_W(t)$; these identities descend through linear localization [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. The same model commutes with finite direct sums, so complete objects form an additive full subcategory.

Direct image preserves completeness by [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Completed pullback is $P_u=C_UL_u$ with its completion unit [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. The local completeness condition equals the intrinsic one [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. The reflector bijection [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector] composed with ordinary adjunction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] gives $\operatorname{Hom}(P_uM,N)=\operatorname{Hom}(L_uM,N)=\operatorname{Hom}(M,D_uN)$. Hence $P_u\dashv D_u$, and both are linear by step 2.

The natural direct-image compositor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] restricts to complete objects. The composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] and uniqueness [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] give $P_vP_u\cong P_{uv}$ with its unit normalization, hence the square comparison $\theta$.
The mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] is exactly the displayed $\alpha$. Naturality of its counit, $\theta$, and unit, successively, gives $D_hP_e(a)\alpha_K=\alpha_{K'}P_fD_g(a)$.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison] with its $(f,f',g,g')=(g,h,f,e)$, so its input corner is our $T$, its $x^a_K=(c^a)^{-1}\mathcal L^a(v^a)s^a:P_fD_gK\to D_hP_eK$, and $v^a=H'^a\mathcal R^a(b)(H^a)^{-1}$ is the strict projection-formula realization of the ambient exchange $b$. Its completeness hypothesis (quotient reconstruction invertible) is our intrinsic one by [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction], since $\mathrm{comp}_K=c_K\kappa_K$ with $c_K$ invertible. Put $\bar K=\operatorname{Res}_TK$, complete by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. (a) Clause (1) gives $\chi_u,\phi_u$ carrying our units, counits and conjugate compositors (step 4) to the constant ones; inserting them in the three factors of $\alpha_K$ gives $\iota_T\operatorname{Res}(\alpha_K)=E^c_{\bar K}\iota_S$, where $\iota_S,\iota_T$ are the source and target composites of clause (3) and $E^c$ is the completed mate of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. (b) Clause (3) gives $\iota_T\operatorname{Res}(x^a_K)=(t^0)^{-1}\mathcal L(E^{\mathcal T}_{\mathcal R\bar K})s^0\iota_S$, and [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison] gives $t^0E^c_{\bar K}=\mathcal L(E^{\mathcal T}_{\mathcal R\bar K})s^0$. Hence $\operatorname{Res}(\alpha_K)=\operatorname{Res}(x^a_K)$. (c) Source and target are complete by step 3, and restriction is an equivalence on complete categories [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], so $\alpha_K=x^a_K$. By clause (2) and the last sentence of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison], the $n$-th evaluation of $v^a$ is the ordinary $P_n$-coefficient exchange, so $x^a_K$ is the completed exchange obtained from the finite-level exchanges. Equalities are of strict-tower morphisms; no geometric hypothesis or inverse exchange is used.
